purpose: One LLM-selected public MCP action demonstration after v1 encountered exhausted OpenRouter free-model quota. Operational recovery, not a retry for a better gate verdict.
origin_selection: LLM chooses from all currently verified compatible origins with complete canonical validation, including separately labelled public runs. No origin or intervention is preselected from the v1 outcome; guardrail cannot substitute an origin.
algorithm: FalkorDB shortestPath over DERIVED_FROM, minimum unweighted hops to passing exact-artifact same-contract ancestor
fallback: Provider failure is labelled and preserved; at most one completed training run in this study. No repeat for a better gate verdict.
paid_inference_authorization: Owner authorized another model using existing OpenRouter credits
